newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Six dead, 21 wounded in Somaliland attack.
newsitem.headline: Six dead, 21 wounded in Somaliland attack.

text.p: Six people were killed in the self-declared republic of Somaliland when gunmen opened fire indiscriminately in Burao town centre, radio reports said on Friday.
A total of 21 people, including seven women, were injured in the incident on Thursday evening 100 km (60 miles) east of the Somaliland capital Hargeisa.

A gunman died in hospital after falling from a "technical" battlewagon used in the attack, local journalists and radio reports said. Technicals patrolled Burao streets on Friday regulating east-west traffic.
Elders from Burao's four main communities and the country's "interior minister" began mediation in a bid to ease tension between local lans.
Somaliland, which has a poulation of around one million, broke away from Somalia under president Mohamed Egal in 1991, but has not been recognised by foreign governments.
